'''Dandy''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Dandy was one of the troopers from [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] to serve alongside [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] during the [[Battle of Lanteeb]].<ref name="Siege" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dandy appeared in the [[2010]] novel, ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''.<ref name="Siege" />
